title: LoveBud repository schema-change inventory
scope: Read-only inventory of every repository path that can create, alter, drop, repair, seed, or otherwise change (or claim to change) the database schema, plus the read-only provenance tooling that bounds such change. This is the first small slice of #3458 (design-work item 1: inventory every schema-changing path). It does not execute SQL, open a database connection, or mutate any environment.
non_goals: No Production, staging, Neon, Firebase, or Cloudflare access.
No SQL execution and no migration application.
No modification of any existing migration, runtime, API, auth, UI, or CI behavior.
No promotion of any legacy path to canonical status; classification is descriptive, not an adoption decision.
relation_to_existing_inventory: docs/architecture/migration-path-inventory.json remains the authoritative detailed provenance inventory for the migration/repair/runbook/seed/diagnostic paths it already covers (per-file checksums and evidence). This inventory is a broader schema-change surface catalog: it carries those classifications forward by cross-reference and adds the schema-execution surface the migration-path inventory does not enumerate (CI ephemeral execution, DB-engine test harnesses, test-fixture SQL, read-only provenance/catalog tooling, the reserved canonical stream, and verified-negative runtime surfaces).
canonical_status_note: Vocabulary is intentionally identical to docs/architecture/migration-path-inventory.json so the two inventories do not diverge. CANONICAL_CANDIDATE means a path is part of the future canonical read-only/provenance direction; it is NOT a claim that the path is an approved Production migration route. The committed canonical migration stream is inactive (ADOPTION_REQUIRED) and empty.

field_definitions.operations: Schema/data operation classes present or described (CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, DROP, TRUNCATE, CREATE INDEX, DROP INDEX, CREATE POLICY, ALTER POLICY, ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, CREATE TRIGGER, DROP TRIGGER, CREATE FUNCTION, DML, READ_ONLY, VALIDATE).
field_definitions.canonical_status: Classification from canonical_status_enum. Descriptive only; not an adoption decision.
field_definitions.destructive: True if the artifact contains destructive DDL (DROP/TRUNCATE/column removal/constraint removal/type narrowing).
field_definitions.production_capable: True if the artifact is technically a route that could change a Production schema when executed by an operator. Read-only validators, ephemeral-CI fixtures/tests, disposable loopback adapters, and pure-JS cores are false.
field_definitions.execution_actor: operator | ci | test_harness | runner | developer | none.
field_definitions.ledger_candidate: Whether the path is a candidate for the future canonical migration ledger: yes | no | pending_owner_decision.
field_definitions.notes: Short evidence and disposition note. Never contains credentials, connection strings, endpoints, database identifiers, row data, or operator identity.

guard.purpose: Static, source-only guard that fails closed when a new schema-changing artifact appears in the repository but is not registered in this inventory. It is an inventory-omission guard, NOT a proof that any PostgreSQL behavior executed correctly.
detection_rules: RULE_SQL: every tracked *.sql file (outside excluded directories) must be registered.

RULE_DDL_SCRIPT: every tracked *.cjs/*.js/*.mjs/*.py file under scripts/, modal_compute/, or functions/ whose content contains a DDL statement pattern (CREATE TABLE/INDEX/POLICY/TRIGGER/SCHEMA, CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION, ALTER TABLE/POLICY, DROP TABLE/INDEX/TRIGGER, TRUNCATE, ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY) must be registered.

RULE_RUNNER_NAME: every tracked non-test *.cjs/*.js/*.mjs/*.py/*.sh/*.ps1 file (outside tests/ and excluded directories) whose basename signals a migration runner or schema repair path (migration|rollback|seed|repair|reconcile|adopt|inspect-schema|verify-db) must be registered.
guard.false_positive_policy: Documentation prose, generated files, vendor files, and the inventory/guard artifacts themselves are explicitly excluded. Test harnesses under tests/ are curated as entries but are not auto-detected by RULE_DDL_SCRIPT/RULE_RUNNER_NAME; *.sql fixtures under tests/db-engine/fixtures/ ARE detected by RULE_SQL and must be registered.
guard.limitation: This guard is a static inventory-completeness check. It does not connect to PostgreSQL, does not run migrations, and does not guarantee runtime schema correctness.

verified_negative_surfaces.notes: Modal Python runtime data-access layer. Verified to contain no literal DDL (CREATE/ALTER/DROP/TRUNCATE/INDEX/POLICY/TRIGGER/SCHEMA). It issues DML only and is not a schema-change path. Schema authority stays out-of-band and separately approved. If future Python adds DDL, RULE_DDL_SCRIPT will require registration.

Cloudflare Pages Functions (same-origin /api entry). Verified to contain no inline DDL and no direct DB schema operations; requests proxy to Modal. Not a schema-change path. If future Function code adds DDL, RULE_DDL_SCRIPT will require registration.

Pre-ledger hardening SQL. DROP/TRUNCATE/DROP COLUMN appear only inside a comment describing a forbidden reversal, not as executed statements. New execution prohibited. Carried forward from migration-path-inventory.json.

Incident reconciliation. Drops/recreates a PK constraint and drops temporary validator functions; DROP TABLE/TRUNCATE/DROP COLUMN are explicitly FORBIDDEN in-file. Service-restoration foothold. Add-if-absent and type-checked; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/TRUNCATE/RENAME are prohibited in-file. Does not establish historical migration provenance. Incident specific. Carried forward from migration-path-inventory.json. Keep #3435 OPEN.

Explicit paired rollback artifact. Drops PK constraint, indexes, columns (owner_id/body/target_kind/target_id), and functions. Not safe to rerun after success; not a generic down-migration. Requires isolated rehearsal and explicit approval. Carried forward from migration-path-inventory.json.

Manual bulk DATA mutation (UPDATE trees / UPDATE memories), not DDL. Out of schema-change scope but inventoried for completeness as a manual data-mutation artifact. No schema objects created/altered. Requires separate approval before any Production use.

Pure-JS provenance gate core. Contains DDL keyword strings only as detection/normalization data; opens no database, runs no SQL, uses no network/shell. Part of the canonical fail-closed gate direction. Detected by RULE_DDL_SCRIPT because of embedded DDL keywords; registered here to satisfy the guard.

Disposable read-only pg_catalog adapter. Loopback + lovebud_ci_* databases only, exact server_version_num=170004, BEGIN READ ONLY, no DATABASE_URL/secret fallback, mutation is not a capability. Contains DDL keyword strings as allowlisted object metadata only. Detected by RULE_DDL_SCRIPT; registered here. Does not authorize Production/staging inspection.
Source-only checker and evidence-comparison gate CLI (npm run check:migration-provenance). No database driver, no network, no shell. Compares repository manifests plus sanitized evidence only.
Lexical SQL normalizer and deterministic SHA-256 object fingerprinter. Operates on already-sanitized structured JSON; opens no database and collects no live catalog.
Explicit --input CLI emitting gate-compatible { name, fingerprint } evidence only. No database connection.
CLI wrapper for the disposable read-only catalog adapter (ephemeral CI loopback only). Emits sanitized evidence only.

Pure validation builder for an inactive expected-schema candidate. Candidate status is always ADOPTION_REQUIRED (never ACTIVE); never writes committed manifests. No database driver/network/shell/stdin.
Explicit evidence-path CLI, stdout-only inactive candidate JSON. Does not activate committed manifests.

Strict adoption-attestation validator. Fails closed on bare/self-attested evidence; prohibits host/connection/secret/operator/raw-row fields. Never reconstructs the canonical migration list from evidence.
Source-only PREPARED_ONLY Production adoption collection plan core. Grants no target access, no SQL authority, no attestation, no manifest activation.
CLI emitting the sanitized PREPARED_ONLY collection plan. Output never claims ATTESTED/ACTIVE/APPLIED.

Fail-closed boundary contract core for a future PRODUCTION_READONLY_CATALOG mode. This artifact opens no Production session and collects no catalog; it defines dedicated-credential, TLS, version-window, and abstract-role boundaries for a later separately approved Phase B child.

Future Production read-only catalog evidence builder. Read-only metadata collection only (BEGIN READ ONLY -> ROLLBACK); no mutation. Requires a dedicated read-only credential and abstract role mapping that do not yet exist; a later Phase B child must reuse the reviewed boundary unchanged. Not usable in this slice.

Production read-only catalog collection runner (npm run collect:production-readonly-catalog). Read-only only; no schema mutation. Requires dedicated key LOVEBUD_PRODUCTION_READONLY_DATABASE_URL under .secrets/ and a separately approved Phase B window. production_capable=false because it cannot mutate schema; it does require Production READ access that is not granted by this slice.
Pure validator for a Phase B collection receipt. No database access; validates sanitized receipt structure only.
